name: 968_merge_song_komar_i_enot_acceptance
_comment: Core S8 invariant (SCHEDULER_DESIGN.md §2.5, issue #968): a non-imperative
topic addition while the robot is mid-song must NOT stop TTS. must_not_call
here is a plain log substring check (harness has no negative-tool-call
concept), so we use it to assert the REPLACE-path markers never fired for
this run: no clear-stop interrupt, no SpeechEvent cancelled (ADR-0150 PR-5:
one interrupt policy; 'Cancel: new STT input' only cancels the LLM turn, not speech).
expected_tool_calls left empty on purpose — whether the LLM actually calls
task_delta to rewrite PENDING segments is the exploratory part of this
live run, not a hard gate yet (S5/S6 prompt-side enforcement not proven
